correctness.rationale: Newton interpolation at q=1..k+1 for F(q)=binom(qk,k) of degree k with F(0)=0 and F(1)=1 gives D(k)|(k+1), eliminating other primes. The source local criterion treats a≤t as exponent 0; for a>t, Kummer carries at j≤a give a−s when s=ν_p(q−1)≤a, and disjoint high boundaries a+t+1≤j≤a+s supply s−t when s>t, forcing every binomial valuation≥a−t. For b=1 the witness q=p produces exactly a carries. For b>1, u=b−p^t lies in (0,p^a) with p∤u, q=1+p^a u is in range; the base-p digit-sum identities for b−1, uk and their sum give exactly a−t carries. These arguments address all k, each p and all q, not just finite samples.
